caption:
Closed the wrong tab? 😅 Bring it back instantly.

Windows or Linux: Ctrl + Shift + T
Mac: Cmd + Shift + T

Works in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Press it again to reopen the one before. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.
